translations.web: I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”
translations.bsb: but I am fiercely angry with the nations that are at ease. For I was a little angry, but they have added to the calamity.’
translations.kjv: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.
translations.asv: And I am very sore displeased with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.
